test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is "**Dilema**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the correct spelling of the word and its meaning.
 
• **Dilemma**: a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially ones that are equally undesirable.
 
 
• **Example**: *She was caught in a **dilemma **when she had to choose between her parents and her lover.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] Hinglish__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct spelling of the word and its meaning.
 
• **Dilemma**: ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें दो या दो से अधिक विकल्पों के बीच एक कठिन चुनाव करना पड़ता है, विशेष रूप से वे जो समान रूप से अवांछनीय हैं।
